security_probation_001.evidence: New teachers shall hold a Provisional License, successfully complete the Entry-Year Program and performance assessment within two years, and obtain a five year Professional License. / Each teacher who has attained the career level in the TES... shall be offered a continuing contract

security_nonrenewal_002.evidence: A contract shall be considered automatically renewed unless notification is given by April 30. / ...entitled to a written notice of the Superintendent's recommendations not to re-employ the teacher... no later than the first Monday in April.

security_seniority_definition_003.evidence: If, among applicants for the vacancy, training, experience, and individual qualifications are substantially equal, seniority shall control the choice, provided that the placement is consistent with the racial balancing of the staff.

security_voluntary_transfer_004.evidence: A teacher who wishes to change teams must submit his/her request in writing to the team leader prior to February 25. / A teacher who desires to change departments must submit his/her request, in writing, to the lead teacher or department chair by February 25.

security_involuntary_transfer_005.evidence: before a teacher receives an administrative transfer... the teacher, upon request, shall have a conference... / Changes in assignments after the initial notification may be necessary due to changes in enrollment... the principal shall notify teachers in writing of the change at the teacher's summer address, including the reasons therefore.

security_rif_006.evidence: reduced-in-force from a second position classification for which s/he holds a current continuing contract, the employee shall have the option of waiving the current continuing contract and reverting to the former continuing contract status
